question: How much imposed membrane conductance at a single node group is needed to suppress cue-window body motion by at least 1% in every region (tail, middle, head) while preserving baseline gait and recovery, and which node groups can do it at all?
motivation: E093-E095: the AWA->AIY->RIA->SMD route delivers too little drive (AWA +2.5 mV becomes <0.05 mV at SMD) and no single edge, even widened, reaches 1%. E076 (older E074 parent) found RIB/RIM depolarization at 0.1 nS suppressed body range 98.6%. This step measures the required node-level drive on the E092 parent so the upstream gain budget can be stated; it does not train anything.
method: No optimizer and no weight change. Parent runs the nominal protocol (cue window 40-50 s, response window 41-46 s, baseline 30-40 s, recovery 60-70 s) with no sensory cue. For each of 60 probe cases an imposed membrane conductance is applied to the named neurons during 40-50 s: 10 node groups x {excitatory (reversal 0 mV), inhibitory (reversal -80 mV)} x {0.01, 0.03, 0.1} nS. One baseline run without a probe. Scores use the existing regional joint angular-speed ratio vs the matched no-cue window, target 1%, margin 1.
parent: Same audited unique passing E092 isolated 1.25 AIYR->AIYL panel as E093-E095; hash pinned at runtime, not invented here.
fixed: All weights, topology/signs, reversals, kinetics, release law, sensory gains, NMJ/muscle/body/water physics and physical clocks. The cue bath is off in every case.
envelope: Conductance <= 0.1 nS and reversal 0 or -80 mV, as in E076; probes outside this are rejected.

budget.workers: up to 21 x 4 physical cores (84 of 128 server CPUs) if available

acceptance_criteria.per_case_gate: A case reaches the target when all three regional ratios are <= 0.99, safe, and baseline/recovery are preserved.
acceptance_criteria.primary_readout: Minimum tested dose per node group and sign that reaches the gate, and the dose-response curve per region.
acceptance_criteria.positive: At least one node group reaches the gate at <= 0.1 nS: that dose is the node-level drive budget for the next step.
acceptance_criteria.negative: No group reaches the gate in every region at <= 0.1 nS: imposed single-node drive within the envelope cannot suppress the whole body, so a different or combined target is needed.
acceptance_criteria.consistency_note: If RIM/RIB excitation at 0.1 nS does not suppress strongly, record the discrepancy with the older E076 (different parent) without explaining it away.

audit: scripts.audit_node_probe runs automatically inside the budget: input/trace hashes, pinned-parent checkpoint, planned-case coverage, probe spec identity, independent score recomputation, retained-trace feature recomputation (0.1 nS cases), pre-probe identity and probe voltage sign.
claims_not_made: No fitting, component qualification, learned stop, start/stop, swimming or biological claim. An imposed conductance is not a sensory cue.
next_step_if_positive: Compare the required drive with the cue-delivered drive at those nodes (E093/E094 detail data) to state the upstream gain budget, then plan the joint upstream training.
